field_descriptions.affected_by: Drugs that affect the test's results.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.normal_range: Range of acceptable values for a typical patient, when applicable.
field_descriptions.sign_detected: A sign detected by the test.
field_descriptions.used_to_diagnose: A condition the test is used to diagnose.
field_descriptions.uses_device: Device used to perform the test.
